prompt: Image 1 is the fixed schematic; image 2 supplies icon style only. Fill all 400 square image regions in the 100 named families. In every family, top-left is Light, top-right is Dark, bottom-left is Active, and bottom-right is Disabled. Repeat the same symbol in all four positions. Light uses a pale tile; Dark uses a dark tile; Active uses a colored accent; Disabled uses subdued gray. Preserve the schematic's family grouping, image order, sizes, positions, gaps, margins, and family captions exactly. Fill each image region edge-to-edge, with no inset or exterior shadow. Use crisp symbols, rounded tiles, and soft internal depth. Remove guide borders and placeholder fills. Add no variant captions. Do not copy the style reference's layout or captions. Scale the whole schematic uniformly if output resolution differs.
